ModMetaData.name: 死手开关：合成体 属性/寻路性能修复 / DMSSR Stat & Path Perf Fix
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
减少《死手开关：合成体》全局属性、健康、寻路与并行预绘制钩子中的重复工作。
1.1.0：修正安装时序，在 DMSSR 启动 PatchAll 完成后启用单次地形 clamp；共享健康快照覆盖改造属性/能力/体型/电量/充电/技能、精神分裂链接与动态能力 provider；无关能力提前返回；普通物品跳过未完成物品 owner 查询；按 ThingDef 缓存飞行与缩放扩展，支持并行读取。
缓存由 HediffSet.DirtyCache、集合引用与数量校验失效。改造参数、provider 输出和渲染扩展字段仍实时读取。唯一有意的数值变化是地形豁免只扣一次地形代价，不再重复扣减。不触碰军团改造资格与研究解锁兼容。纯运行时 Harmony 补丁，不增加存档字段，可随时安全添加或移除。
Reduces repeated work in Synthriada's global stat, health, pathing and parallel pre-draw hooks. Version 1.1.0 waits for DMSSR's startup PatchAll before removing the duplicate terrain clamp, shares invalidated health lookups across customization/link/provider paths, gates irrelevant capacities, skips display-owner checks for ordinary things, and caches render extensions per ThingDef with thread-safe reads.
Live modifier values and upstream rendering remain intact. Terrain cost is intentionally subtracted once rather than twice. Legion eligibility/research compatibility hooks are untouched. Pure runtime Harmony patch with no save fields; safe to add or remove at any time.
